This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed on 
yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The 
relay circuit, tuned to the supply frequency, rejects the harmonics produced by 
current transformer saturation. A slight time delay on operation helps to 
provide stability on heavy external faults and is obtained by allowing the 
auto-transformer to saturate above the relay setting. This limits the current 
supplied, and the attracted armature unit operates only on the slower part of 
its time-current

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmad Galal, tested by eng. Mohamed 
Rabee, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Gaber 
Farahat WDEPC inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
A work permit must be issued.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.

 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed on 
yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The 
relay circuit, tuned to the supply frequency, rejects the harmonics produced by 
current transformer saturation. A slight time delay on operation helps to 
provide stability on heavy external faults and is obtained by allowing the 
auto-transformer to saturate above the relay setting. This limits the current 
supplied, and the attracted armature unit operates only on the slower part of 
its time-current
The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmad Galal, tested by eng. Mohamed 
Rabee, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Gaber 
Farahat WDEPC inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.
A work permit must be issued.
The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc
The transformer must be was isolated.
Make sure CT Secondary circuits are shorted.
Ensure all CT path 
 elements are secure after any test disturbance
Tools and Equipment
ISA test set type ART/3 or Omicron
Voltmeter, Ammeter, test plug, and test leads
Work to be Carried Out
Relays Preparation
Review the manual and drawings.
Prepare the previous or commissioning results of the relay testing.
Check the wires of the relay by hand.
Check the AC source is available to the tester.
Check the existence of the DC sources in panels.
Disconnect the trip leads of the relay and connect one of them to the timer of 
 the tester.
Check all the leads used in tests.
Test Steps
Connect the current leads of a tester unit to the relay points according to 
 the drawings and scheme.
the 1st in testing. on element O/C.
Inject current to each couple of points (1-2) on the element o/c till the red 
 flag of the device displays.
Record the results pick up value at 1.1A.
Decrees the current until the relay is reset and measure the current at reset 
 0.95A.
Record the results reset value at 0.95A.
time test in the relay is connect terminal timer to (7_8)on relay as connect 
 terminal unit current to (1_2)on relay as inject the current to pick up relay 
 and Record the results time .t=3sec.
the 2nd in testing. On element direction
Inject current to each couple of points (1-2) on the element direction till 
 the red flag of the device displays. And inject voltage on point (3_4) 60v
Record the results pick up value at 20mA.
Decrees the current until the relay is reset and measure the current at reset 
 15mA.
Record the results reset value at 15mA.
Switch off secondary injection t test set.
Return the relay to the panel.
Return all connections to the normal position as before the test.
Close the work permit
